# Full-suite skipped test classification

Source: [Ubuntu job 119234756949](https://github.com/fenerax/chunk-picker-rs3/actions/runs/39603812368/job/119234756949), from `full: 590 test files` through the final full-lane summary. The Node summary reports 116 skips. The log contains 111 ordinary `# SKIP` records and five `t.skip()` records with descriptive reasons; together these account for all 116. Every test title, source file and skip reason is recorded in `coverage-classification.json`. No Windows fixture needs the live save or personal values.

The slice also runs other Windows-gated files whose Ubuntu cases did not skip because their guards were satisfied on Ubuntu (for example `watchdog-script.test.mjs`, which can use installed `pwsh`). The hosted Windows log for run `39603812368` is from the earlier 17-file slice configuration; it confirms 17/17 configured files ran, with 183 tests passed and 0 failed or skipped. `release-pipeline-v2.test.mjs` passed its isolated retry after an initial failure. It does not provide run evidence for the five newly added files.

## Reconciliation

| Category | Cases |
|---|---:|
| A: Windows-only | 107 |
| B: reproducible public/local input | 6 |
| C: private or paired-source input | 3 |
| **Total** | **116** |

Expected Ubuntu skipped count with the current pins: **112**, down from 116.
Four class-B cases now receive their inputs. The remaining 112 are the 107
Windows cases, three reviewed class-C cases, and two class-B artifact gaps.
With an authentic guide export added to the selected data pack, setup will
automatically configure `RS3_SKILL_GUIDES_EXPORT` and the expected count becomes
111. Supplying and routing the authentic resource masks would reduce it to 110.
The `coverage` job remains red for both missing public-input cases; neither is
an allowlist exception. A fixed PC path alone does not establish private data.

Local checks used disposable input/report directories, one test file at a time.
The 300 pinned Wiki revisions fetched successfully; the real-cache rebuild
passed byte-for-byte. The selected public packs passed both scrubbed-pack tests,
and the selected public art passed all PNG checks. Synthetic gate artifacts prove
the CLI rejects an unexecuted public-input test and accepts its passing result.
These checks do not substitute for a run of the changed workflow on GitHub.

The release consumer's required-job list lives outside this task's write scope.
Its owner must add `coverage` to the exact-commit release requirements.
